workarounds.symptom: [BUG] Answered attended-transfer leg hanging up before a digit ends the whole call
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(attended-transfer): resume caller if destination hangs up early. Target files: src/engine.py, admin_ui/frontend/src/pages/ToolsPage.test.tsx, tests/test_attended_transfer_streaming.py. . An attended-transfer destination that answers and hangs up before acceptance now resumes the caller instead of tearing down the entire call. Recovery runs once, stops MOH, records `target-hangup` (or `declined` when already received), and restores caller capture. (Ref: https://github.com/hkjarral/AVA-AI-Voice-Agent-for-Asterisk/pull/830)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] Attended-transfer answer handler ignores the call's per-call tool snapshot
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(attended-transfer): read the call's tool snapshot when the leg answers. The attended-transfer answer handler and its failure-recovery path read live global `tools.attended_transfer` / `tools.transfer.destinations` from `self.config.tools`, while `AttendedTransferTool.execute` originates the destination leg from the call's own tool snapshot via `_tool_config_for_session`.
